slackdump_thread_replies.text:
No worries there - they should show up in tomorrow's sheet.

The logic to generate the sheet is:
• first, get all videos published yesterday
• second, starting from day before yesterday, get all the videos that are *not tagged*, upto a max of 1000 videos
So anything you miss today, will keep appearing in subsequent sheets until it gets really old and falls off the 1000 rows mark.

messages.text:
<@U04G02LPZ6W> I figured out which case received the 'Future of Sex' tag when it should have been 'Finance'. It is this piece here: <https://www.instagram.com/p/DYVyU43jfDG/>.

The tags are generated from the titles. In this case, the title was: *'Denise Anders was working in marketing when she started camming. That led her to fetish wrestling studios in the backstreets of London.'*

So the AI picked up on the 'fetish' word and inferred 'Future of Sex'. The thing is that this tag was reviewed by a human that kept it.
